subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: J. Edgar Hoover's Wiretaps
description: One-minute skill: J. Edgar Hoover's Wiretaps.

hook.text: FBI Director J. Edgar Hoover wiretapped activists, politicians, and even presidents for decades.

buildup.text: Hoover used surveillance to build files on anyone he considered a threat — or a political rival.

discovery.text: He recorded Martin Luther King Jr.'s conversations and tried to blackmail him into silence.

twist.text: Hoover operated with almost no oversight. Presidents feared him because he knew their secrets.

climax.text: When Hoover died in 1972, the full scale of his illegal surveillance shocked the entire nation.

punchline.text: He surveilled everyone. Nobody surveilled him.

quiz.question: How did J. Edgar Hoover maintain power for decades?
options: By collecting surveillance files on powerful people
